description:
Hushfeed v0.71.2 has 132 patches for global TikTok 47.1.4 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

47.1.4 is still the only supported version, so patch that APK with your usual signing key.

A quick follow-up to 0.71.1. Hide the status bar in LIVE rooms and Show a LIVE under the status bar now work on a LIVE opened from the preview under a creator's card in search, which TikTok opens inside the page it uses for opened videos. The release notes list every report 0.71.0 through 0.71.2 changed something for.

Validation: 3876 runtime tests passed and 765 patch tests passed locally. Both Android lint checks passed. All 132 patches applied to the supported APK with resource and manifest checks. The attached release receipt identifies the exact source and bundle. Patched onto TikTok 47.1.4 on a Galaxy S22, a LIVE opened from a creator's card in search got both status bar switches.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source to update. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
